description: Evaluation cases for integrity-auditor v7 — aligned with skill boundary (four-level citation classification, numerical check, shared AI patterns, no auto-delete)

cases.description: Audit report must record all four citation verification levels (verified/unverified/suspicious/fabricated) — integrity-auditor is single source of truth
cases.prompt: 检查我的所有引用是否真实存在，并按验证状态分级

cases.description: Audit report must include numerical consistency cross-check between abstract, body, and tables
cases.prompt: 审查论文中的数字，检查摘要、正文和表格是否一致

cases.description: AI writing detection must reference shared patterns file, not maintain its own list
cases.prompt: 检测论文中是否有明显的AI写作痕迹，按严重程度分级报告

cases.description: Auditor must recommend, never auto-delete citations
cases.prompt: 发现疑似不存在的引用后，处理该引用

cases.description: Audit checks that every table/figure has a source file
cases.prompt: 检查论文中的每张表格和图形是否都有对应的源文件

cases.description: Complete audit covers all four dimensions with proper boundary compliance
cases.prompt: 对论文进行全面的学术诚信审查：引用验证、数字一致性、AI写作痕迹、数据可追溯性

cases.description: Should NOT trigger for paper writing request
cases.prompt: 帮我写一段研究背景的介绍

cases.description: Should NOT trigger for regression analysis
cases.prompt: 运行DID回归并输出结果表格
